title_en: Prophetic Measures to Preserve the Caliphate from the Umayyad Coup - Part 47
description_en: المرجعية والخلافة بعد الرسول(ص) 6 / جمادي الأول /1433
summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses the measures taken by the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) to protect the caliphate from an Umayyad coup.
series_en: Muṭarahat fi al-Aqida - Al-Marja'iyya wal-Khilafa ba'd al-Rasul
